name: Metal-filings contact detector
summary: A tube of loose metal filings whose electrical resistance drops when struck by electrical waves, later used to detect signals in early wireless experiments.
description: A granular metallic-contact device whose conductivity changes under electrical disturbance; this filings device is the predecessor Marconi calls a Branly coherer.
tier_reason: A bounded technical contribution, transmission episode or documented configuration useful within a specific history; no broad dependence claim is established.

impact.note: A more sensitive detector of electrical waves, used by early wireless experimenters and operators, on which the first generation of wireless telegraph receivers was built.
